subject: gk
question: A father was speaking about the rich cultural heritage of India to his young son and his teenager friends. The fundamental duty in which Article was the father promoting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51A (f).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51A (f):- **

 
 
• The father was promoting the fundamental duty mentioned in Article 51A (f), to value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture.
 
• This duty emphasizes the importance of unity in diversity and the need to respect and celebrate the different cultural traditions of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Article 51A (e):-**

 
 
• It mentions the duty to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India transcending religious, linguistic, and regional or sectional diversities and to renounce practices derogatory to the dignity of women,
 
 
 
• **Article 51A (d):-**
 
 
• It mentions the duty to defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so,
 
 
 
• **Article 51A (c):-**
 
 
• It mentions the duty to uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India,
